book.name: 2 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Amanaga ga Mungu kobhegero bhyo obhototo
Mmbe, kʉ kʉbha Mungu atʉhɨɨrɨ omoremo gʉnʉ kʉbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ, tʉtakukwa umwʉyʉ.

Twangirɨ kokora amangʼana gi imbisi na ga zɨsʉni. Tʉtakʉkangirirya abhaatʉ, na tʉtakʉsanginʼya ɨngʼana ya Mungu nʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ. Nawe, tʉragamba amaheene habhwɨrʉ, korereke abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhamenye mozekoro zaabhʉ itwɨ nɨ‑bhaatʉ bhe eheene mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu.
Nawe arɨɨbhɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yɨnʉ tʉkʉraganʼya ɨtakomenyekana, nɨ‑kʉbhanʉ bhakurimɨra abheene.

Abhaatʉ bhayo bhatakwisirirya Yɨɨsu, kʉ kʉbha Shɨtaani, ʉmʉtɨmi wɨ ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ, ahukwiryɨ amangʼɨɨni gaabhʉ. Kiyo necho kikugirirya bharatamwa korora ubhwɨrʉ bhwɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwa Kiriisitʉ, newe ekerenjo cha Mungu.
Itwɨ tʉtakwirwazɨra itubheene, nawe tʉrarwaza kʉbha Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ newe Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, na niitwɨ, nɨ‑bhambʉʉsa bhaanyu igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu.
Mungu akabhuga, “Ubhwɨrʉ bhʉbhanzɨ mukiirimya.”
Ewe newe abhanzirɨ mozekoro zɨɨtʉ, na kotokora komenya ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwazɨ, mubhushʉ bhwa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Nawe itwɨ bhanʉ tuni ikibhumbɨkʉ kiyo, twangɨ ebhegero bhɨnʉ bhibhumbirwɨ kobhototo, korereke emenyekanɨ kʉbha, amanaga amakʉrʉ go okokora emeremo giyo gararwa kwa Mungu, ɨtarɨ kwa niitwɨ.
Tʉrabhona zɨnyaakʉ nzaru, nawe tʉtakʉtamwa. Tʉrabhona ʉrʉhaho, nawe tʉtakukwa umwʉyʉ.
Tʉranyaakibhwa, nawe Mungu atakututiga. Bharatorekera, nawe tʉtakukwa.
Zisikʉ zʉʉsi ɨmɨbhɨrɨ jɨtʉ gɨrɨ mʉtabhaaribhaari yu ukukwa ncha Yɨɨsu, korereke ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa Yɨɨsu bhororekanɨ mʉmɨbhɨrɨ jɨtʉ.
Itwɨ abhahʉru, tʉragenda nu uruku ribhaga ryʉsi igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu, korereke ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ bhororekanɨ mʉmɨbhɨrɨ jɨtʉ gɨnʉ gikukwa.
Mmbe, kʉrɨngʼaana ne emeremo jɨtʉ, itwɨ tʉrɨ mʉmabhɨ gu uruku, nawe kʉhɨtɨra gayo, imwɨ mʉrabhona ʉbhʉhʉru.
Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu garabhuga, “Nikiisirirya necho nɨgambirɨ.”
Na itwʉsi turiisirirya, necho tʉkʉgamba.
Tʉmɨnyirɨ kʉbha, Mungu wʉnʉ aamuryurirɨ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, araturyʉra iitwɨ chɨmbu aamuryurirɨ Yɨɨsu. Ewe aratoreeta hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwazɨ.
Amangʼana gʉʉsi ganʉ tokobhona ni‑gʉrʉ waanyu, korereke ɨbhɨgʉngi bhya Mungu rʉbhahikɨrɨ abhaatʉ bhaaru kʉkɨraho, na Mungu akumibhwɨ. Na kuriyo arangʼeha kugungibhwa.
Ʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwa kemerano
Mmbe tʉtakukwa umwʉyʉ. Nangabha ɨmɨbhɨrɨ jɨtʉ gɨrakunguha, nawe Mungu aratokora bhahya sikʉ zʉʉsi.
Nɨragambabhu, kʉ kʉbha ɨnyaakʉ yɨɨtʉ nɨ‑hʉhʉ na yi ibhaga isuuhubhu. Na ɨratokorera ʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwa kemerano, bhʉnʉ bhokongʼeha kʉbha bhwaru bhʉkʉngʼu.
Tʉtarora ebhegero bhɨnʉ bhekororekana, nawe torore bhɨnʉ bhɨtakororekana, kʉ kʉbha bhɨnʉ bhekororekana ni‑bhyi ibhaga isuuhubhu, nawe, bhɨnʉ bhɨtakororekana, ni‑bhya kemerano.
